seo.title: openIndu-station Overview | openIndu
seo.description: openIndu-station is a motion-vision-scan universal equipment platform incubating in the openIndu community, already running a dual-camera precision dispensing machine and a dual-platform laser cutting machine.
seo.keywords: openIndu-station,universal equipment platform,motion control,machine vision,hand-eye calibration,template matching,dispensing machine,laser cutting machine

intro.heading: What It Is
intro.description: A motion-vision-scan universal equipment platform incubating in the openIndu community. It folds axis motion, machine vision, and barcode scanning into a single station framework, so one platform codebase can carry custom equipment across different processes. Its vision module already drives two real products — a dual-camera precision dispensing machine and a dual-platform laser cutting machine.

matching.title: Template Matching + Blob Dual Engine
matching.description: Contour, circle, line, and corner detection with sub-pixel precision

products.heading: Equipment Built On It
products.description: One platform framework, configured by process into two structurally different production machines.

dispensing.title: Dual-Camera Precision Dispensing Machine
dispensing.description: Load → scan → pre-align → transfer → fine-align → dispense → inspect → unload — fully automated across three workstations
